item.immersive_trains.rotary_cannon.desc: Fluchfinnende kanon dy't mei kanonpoeder operearret.
item.immersive_trains.bomb_bay.descripti: Falt TNT, ferneat gjin blokken mar docht swiere skea.
item.immersive_trains.telescope.descript: In súverder ferzje fan de spyglass.
item.immersive_trains.heavy_crossbow.des: In swier krúsboar mei in krêftig skot, fereasket piken.
item.immersive_trains.airship.descriptio: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.immersive_trains.cargo_airship.desc: Langsam en brânstof hongerich mar draacht in hiele opslach.
item.immersive_trains.warship.descriptio: In fleander festing, trage mar ek swier bewapene.
item.immersive_trains.biplane.descriptio: Fluch en frij betrouber. Soargje derfoar dat jo startbaan lang genôch is.
item.immersive_trains.gyrodyne.descripti: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.immersive_trains.quadrocopter.descr: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.immersive_trains.bamboo_hopper.desc: In chonky fleantúch mei trije sitten en pontoanen om feilich op wetter te lânjen.
immersive_trains.gyrodyne_target_reached: Minimale rotor snelheid berikt, klear foar opstigen!
immersive_trains.invalid_dimension: Dit luchtskip wurket net yn dizze dimensje.
immersive_trains.tried_dismount: Druk noch in kear om te springen!
immersive_trains.fat.out: Jo binne te hongerich om te fleanen!
